title: Reimplement BPSK compatibility surface on the modem framework
description:
Back the current BPSK entry points with the shared modem framework so existing BPSK users keep working without preserving a separate modem implementation.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Existing BPSK-facing helpers are implemented as framework-backed adapters or equivalent wrappers.
- [ ] BPSK call sites do not require bespoke modulation logic outside the shared modem framework.
- [ ] No standalone BPSK implementation remains as an alternative source of modem functionality.
- [ ] Compatibility is preserved for the existing simulation-facing surface.

## Notes

This task handles the BPSK migration half of the legacy-surface cleanup story and should converge behavior onto the single shared modem implementation.
